name: @harborline-software/rule-authoring
description: Calculation authoring bridge (ADR 0146 D2/D5) — the Harborline port of the Harborline App rules authoring lane: decision-table and formula drafts, draft-to-skin lowering onto @harborline-software/rule-engine, advisory lint, blank seeds, the publish admission fence, and the versioned named-rule catalog over a pluggable store port (the Harborline replacement for the pinned localStorage interim).
